searchText: is there a more authoritative or more detailed version of the devp2p spec than this? https://github.com/ethereum/devp2p/blob/master/discv4.md#ping-packet-0x01 asking because we are getting reports of clients not sending complete PING messages, and I am implementing handling them. I've allowed for PING messages to omit the `from` endpoint, despite the spec not indicating they are optional now i'm about to add support for a from endpoint with no host address, but only the UDP port to use, and I'm wondering if it is wise to support that when the spec does not indicate that it should be allowed <@194432762315407360> would be the best person to ask, bet I think that page is the best. The 'from' endpoint is not always known to clients, so it's OK to not send it properly. This field is legacy and you can't really do anything with it When responding, you need to send back to the envelope address instead (the ip/port you got the UDP packet from) I'm happy to add this in the spec text. The spec that was linked is the canonical one.
